Lives in a card-header tabs layout for tabs that don't fit. Both wrappers ship it: svelte `TabsOverflow` (toggle snippet + children → menu), keen `tabs_overflow/1` (added 2026-10-07 for parity — `:toggle` slot + inner_block → menu, requires `id`). Like tabs-scrollable this is `compareOnly` — a single component SHARING the `pa-tabs` block that tabs.json owns, so check-all skips the per-block capability reverse-check but the dumpers render it normally. The `--open` menu state is JS-toggled (not SSR) so it's not exercised; `__overflow*` element classes are deferred FROM tabs.json TO this fixture (verified fixture-ref). Wiring trimmed via normalize: keen's wrapper/menu `id` (+ the JS phx-click-away/phx-click handled globally), svelte's `aria-label` (i18n) + `aria-expanded` (reactive). `aria-haspopup="menu"` is a real a11y contract both emit → kept.
